decision: CANON/PL consulting layer (MCP/bot queries against the codebase) runs on Muse servers (local VM), not Cloudflare Workers. Codebase mirrored to Cloudflare via cheap storage (R2), not Workers, until paid tier.
rationale: Do not burn Cloudflare free-tier read quota on constant codebase reads until the operator can pay.
rejected_alternative: Serve codebase reads through Cloudflare Workers
title: CANON/PL serving stays on Muse servers, not Cloudflare Workers
